source_policy: Public BIS-operated service guidance; no full Indian Standards text or live registry data

entries.title: Compulsory certification & QCOs
questions: Is BIS certification mandatory for every product?
Do all products need BIS certification?
Is BIS certification compulsory for all products?
What is a Quality Control Order?
entries.answer: BIS product certification is generally voluntary. A Quality Control Order can make certification compulsory for a specified product. Check the current BIS list and the linked order for your exact product and effective date.
followUps: How do I apply for the ISI Mark?
What is the BIS Compulsory Registration Scheme?

entries.title: Applying for the ISI Mark
questions: How do I apply for the ISI Mark?
How do I get a BIS product certification licence?
How can I apply for ISI certification?
How to apply for the ISI Mark?
entries.answer: First identify the applicable Indian Standard and check whether your product falls under a current QCO. BIS publishes Scheme I grant guidelines, product-specific information and the application route. Use those instructions for the actual documents, testing, fees and assessment.
followUps: Is BIS certification mandatory for every product?
Where can I find BIS recognised laboratories?

entries.title: CRS registration
questions: What is the BIS Compulsory Registration Scheme?
How does BIS CRS registration work?
What is BIS CRS?
Explain the BIS Compulsory Registration Scheme
entries.answer: The BIS Compulsory Registration Scheme is a separate route for notified product categories. The CRS portal lists product standards and explains test requests, recognised laboratory testing and online registration. Check the exact category before applying.
followUps: Where can I find BIS recognised laboratories?
Is BIS certification mandatory for every product?

entries.title: Checking a jewellery HUID
questions: How can I verify a HUID?
Where can I check a jewellery HUID?
How do I check a HUID?
How to verify HUID?
entries.answer: Use the Verify HUID feature in the official BIS CARE app, then compare the returned jewellery details with the item. BISynapse cannot authenticate a HUID from a typed code or photo.
followUps: How can I verify a BIS licence?
How do I file a BIS consumer complaint?

entries.title: Checking a BIS licence
questions: How can I verify a BIS licence?
How do I check an ISI licence number?
How do I check a BIS license?
How to verify a BIS licence?
entries.answer: Use Verify Licence Details in the official BIS CARE app and compare the returned record with the mark and product. BISynapse does not query the live licence registry.
followUps: How can I verify a HUID?
How do I file a BIS consumer complaint?

entries.title: Finding recognised laboratories
questions: Where can I find BIS recognised laboratories?
How do I find a BIS lab for my standard?
Where can I find BIS recognized labs?
How to find a BIS recognised laboratory?
entries.answer: Search BIS LIMS for a recognised laboratory and check its current scope against the Indian Standard you need tested. A laboratory listing alone does not show that every test is within its recognition scope.
followUps: How do I apply for the ISI Mark?
What is the BIS Compulsory Registration Scheme?

entries.title: Consumer complaints
questions: How do I file a BIS consumer complaint?
Where can I complain about a BIS marked product?
How can I complain to BIS?
How to file a BIS complaint?
entries.answer: BIS accepts consumer complaints offline and online. Its online complaint page directs users to BIS CARE or the official complaint portal. Use that route for a case-specific response and keep the product and mark details available.
followUps: How can I verify a BIS licence?
How can I verify a HUID?

entries.title: Foreign manufacturers
questions: What is the Foreign Manufacturers Certification Scheme?
Can a foreign manufacturer apply for BIS certification?
What is BIS FMCS?
How do foreign manufacturers get BIS certification?
entries.answer: BIS operates the Foreign Manufacturers Certification Scheme for eligible manufacturers outside India seeking a licence to use the Standard Mark. The BIS overview points electronics and IT goods notified by MeitY toward the separate CRS route.
followUps: What is the BIS Compulsory Registration Scheme?
Is BIS certification mandatory for every product?

entries.title: Management systems certification
questions: Does BIS certify management systems?
What is BIS management systems certification?
Does BIS offer quality management system certification?
entries.answer: Yes. BIS operates management systems certification schemes, including quality and environmental management systems. This is a different route from certifying a product under Scheme I or registering one under CRS.
followUps: How do I apply for the ISI Mark?
What is the BIS Compulsory Registration Scheme?

entries.title: Finding an Indian Standard
questions: Where can I find an Indian Standard?
How do I use Know Your Standard?
How can I search BIS standards?
Where can I find standard amendments?
entries.answer: Use the official Know Your Standard portal to search by Indian Standard number or a product keyword. BIS says it brings together the selected standard, amendments and related documents, with linked licence and laboratory information. Confirm the current edition and the relevant documents there; a prototype search result does not establish applicability.
followUps: Is BIS certification mandatory for every product?
Where can I find BIS recognised laboratories?

entries.title: Product certification fees
questions: Where can I find BIS certification fees?
How do I check BIS marking fees?
Where can I check MSME fee concessions?
entries.answer: The BIS product certification fee page links a marking-fee search by Indian Standard, the Scheme I fee list, and notification amendments. Check those current documents for the applicable fee and any concession conditions. This guide does not calculate a total application cost or determine concession eligibility; CRS and other schemes have their own fee routes.
followUps: How do I apply for the ISI Mark?
What is the BIS Compulsory Registration Scheme?

entries.title: Jeweller registration
questions: How does a jeweller register with BIS?
Where can I find BIS jeweller registration guidance?
How do I apply for jeweller registration?
entries.answer: Start with the official BIS Jewellers Registration Scheme page. It links the registration procedure, guidelines for jewellers and the licensed-jeweller list. Follow the linked procedure for an application and check current hallmarking requirements separately. BISynapse does not submit an application or confirm a jeweller's registration status.
